title: Shield joined by a side face, on an open board, lifts off upwards
why: The shield (50 x 30 x 10) sits on the UNO (50 x 30 x 2, z 0 to 2) at z 3 to 13, but was joined by a side face, so its joint points +y. Nothing is in the way sideways, but a person takes a shield off its board by lifting it: +z. Sliding it off sideways is the bug in Kev's SMARS picture.
